# Personnel Record Update: Keiko Sandoval
Effective date: 06/15/2026 | HRIS transaction: SB-28417

## Employee and event
Employee: Keiko Sandoval | Employee ID: 006184
Event: Promotion and department transfer
Approved by: Paul Sato, Director of Operations | Entered by: Tyrone Kowalczyk, HR Specialist

The approved change notice moves Sandoval from Customer Support Specialist to Customer Support Team Lead, effective 06/15/2026. Her new department is Client Operations, and her new manager is Lena Brooks. Work location remains Stonebridge's Dayton, Ohio office. Employment status remains full-time, nonexempt; scheduled hours remain 40 per week.

## Compensation
Current annualized base pay is $64,000.00; approved new annualized base pay is $67,200.00, effective 06/15/2026. The change notice states a 6.25% increase. Payroll frequency remains biweekly, with no change to benefit elections or tax withholding.

## HRIS actions
Update job title, department, manager, and compensation effective 06/15/2026. Keep Paul Sato listed as Sandoval's current manager after the transfer. Preserve the prior job and compensation history as effective through 06/14/2026; do not overwrite historical rows. Route the transaction to Payroll for the 06/26/2026 pay run and retain the signed change notice in the restricted personnel file.

## Onboarding record reference
Sandoval's first day of employment was 06/08/2026. Form I-9 Section 2 was completed on 06/12/2026, within three business days of her start date. The onboarding file contains the signed offer letter, tax withholding forms, and identity and work-authorization documentation. Access to these records is limited to authorized HR staff.

errors.quote: The change notice states a 6.25% increase
errors.explanation: The increase is $3,200 on a $64,000 base, which is 5%, not 6.25%.
errors.fix: The change notice states a 5% increase

errors.quote: Keep Paul Sato listed as Sandoval's current manager
errors.explanation: The approved change notice names Lena Brooks as Sandoval’s new manager effective 06/15/2026. Keeping Paul Sato listed as current conflicts with the documented transfer.
errors.fix: List Lena Brooks as Sandoval’s current manager

errors.quote: completed on 06/12/2026, within three business days
errors.explanation: For a 06/08/2026 start, the first three business days after the first day are 06/09, 06/10, and 06/11. Completing Section 2 on 06/12 misses the federal I-9 deadline.
errors.fix: completed on 06/11/2026, within three business days
